en-US.summary: An ambient dashboard for your Echo Show: live dual-timezone clock, weather, and a rotating cinematic background.
en-US.name: Home Dashboard
en-US.description: Turns your Echo Show into an ambient dashboard: a live clock for two timezones, current weather, and a slowly rotating cinematic city background. Stays on screen until you say stop, quit, close, or exit.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'Alexa, open home dashboard' to launch. Say 'Alexa, stop', 'quit', 'close', or 'exit' to close it.
